text: NAVIGATING THE TRANSITION TO A DECENTRALIZED GOVERNANCE MODEL FOR STATE UNIVERSITIES IN UZBEKISTAN presents the following source proposition: This article discusses the challenges and opportunities involved in transitioning state universities in Uzbekistan to a decentralized corporate governance model.
